answer: Require every identity to register one mailbox verified by a mailed code: like a pearl hidden in a shell, the code reaches only one real address. Each fake costs $8 a month plus $2 postage, so the bill scales linearly and 100 fakes cost $1,000 a month. A juniper hedge of rotating spot-checks re-mails fresh codes, and only identities that summit the delivery proof stay eligible.
